title: Capitolo 2 · Documents, calendar, family and describing people
shortDescription: Fill in a form with your personal details, count to 100, say dates, days and months, use the definite articles and plurals, the full verbs essere and avere, talk about your family with possessives and describe people with adjectives.
description:
Part of the official SS Europa Italian course used in our classes, for learners from India, Pakistan and Bangladesh who are going to Italy to work, study or live. Chapters 1–7 take you from zero to level A1 and Chapters 8–12 to level A2 — study them in order.

Every 60-minute class of the chapter is split into three short lessons you can study on your phone, with pictures, audio, grammar tables and exercises. Every word comes with its English and Punjabi meaning, the slides of each class are attached as PDF, and the chapter ends with a test (pass mark 60%).
objectives:
I can fill in a form with my personal details (nome, cognome, data di nascita, indirizzo…)
I can count from 21 to 100 and say my date of birth
I can say the days of the week and the months of the year
I can use il / lo / la / l' / i / gli / le and make regular plurals
I can use all the forms of essere and avere
I can talk about my family with mio / mia / i miei / le mie
I can describe people with adjectives and ask Chi è? Com'è? Quanti?

lessons.title: Lesson 2 · The definite articles
lessons.summary: il / i · lo / gli · l' / gli · la / le · l' / le

blocks.title: Articoli maschili: IL / I · LO / GLI · L' / GLI
table: il giorno → i giorni · il documento → i documenti
masculine + Z, S + consonant, GN, PS
lo zaino → gli zaini · lo studente → gli studenti
masculine + vowel (A, E, I, O, U)
l'anno → gli anni · l'indirizzo → gli indirizzi

blocks.title: Articoli femminili: LA / LE · L' / LE
table: la settimana → le settimane · la firma → le firme · la chiave → le chiavi
feminine + vowel (no apostrophe in the plural!)
l'aula → le aule · l'ora → le ore · l'amica → le amiche

blocks.title: Good to know
blocks.body: In the plural, feminine words always take **LE**, without apostrophe: *l'aula → le aule* (Punjabi: bahuvachan vich hamesha LE, bina apostrophe).

lessons.title: Lesson 3 · Possessives: mio, tuo, suo…
lessons.summary: My, your, his, her, our, their — and the golden rule for family words.

blocks.title: Regola d'oro: possessivi e famiglia
blocks.body:
**Singular family word → NO article**
- mio padre (NO "il mio padre")
- tua madre (NO "la tua madre")
- suo fratello · nostra sorella

**Plural, and with LORO → WITH the article**
- i miei fratelli · le mie sorelle
- i nostri genitori
- il loro padre · la loro madre

blocks.title: Good to know
blocks.body: **Suo / sua** means both *his* and *her*: it agrees with the thing owned, not with the owner. *Marco e sua sorella* (Marco and his sister) · *Anna e suo fratello* (Anna and her brother).

blocks.title: Attività: parla della famiglia
blocks.body:
1. **Sei sposato/a o celibe/nubile?** — Are you married or single? (Ki tusi viahe ho?)

lessons.title: Lesson 4 · Noun–adjective agreement
lessons.summary: Adjectives with 4 forms (-o, -a, -i, -e) and with 2 forms (-e, -i).

blocks.title: Aggettivi a 2 forme (-E → -I)
table: mio fratello / mia sorella è giovane
i miei fratelli / le mie sorelle sono giovani
il signore / la signora è gentile
i signori / le signore sono gentili

blocks.title: Good to know
blocks.body: The adjective takes the **gender and number** of the noun: la ragazza alt**a**, i ragazzi alt**i**. Adjectives in **-e** have only two forms: *gentile → gentili*.

blocks.title: Intervista il tuo compagno (interview your partner)
blocks.body:
1. **Chi è il tuo migliore amico / la tua migliore amica?** — Si chiama…
2. **Com'è?** (alto/basso, giovane/anziano, simpatico, gentile…) — È alto/a, giovane e molto simpatico/a!
3. **Quanti anni ha? Quanti fratelli o sorelle ha?** — Ha … anni e ha … fratelli / … sorelle.

lessons.title: Chapter 2 test
lessons.summary: Listening, documents, calendar, family, articles, plurals, essere / avere, possessives and adjectives. Pass mark: 60%.

blocks.title: Test Capitolo 2
blocks.body:
This test checks everything in Chapter 2 (Lessons 1–4).

- **1. Listening** — days, months, documents, family, adjectives and numbers 21–100
- **2. Vocabulary** — documents, calendar, family and adjectives
- **3. Grammar** — articles and plurals, essere / avere, possessives, agreement and questions
- **4. Writing** — sentences about your family

You need **60%** to pass. You can repeat the test as many times as you like.
